checks.evidence: One shared-edge incidence build and exact unoriented-plane BFS. Reversed winding stays in its component. Boundary, front sign, referenced extent and exact area are checked. Unsupported component source indices are retained.
build_index_from_parsed skips only triangles belonging to the current ROI. Every other source triangle, including same-object unsupported faces, enters the existing common narrow phase.
Depth, RGB, object owner and patch owner use the identical nearer mask. Unsupported face ID -1 overwrites a prior patch winner. Existing default two-buffer and return_owner three-buffer paths remain.

Mapping identity includes ordered vertices/faces, stable ROI order and complete face-to-patch arrays. Frame and NPZ version/identity/ROI list/mapping arrays are checked. Historical three buffers remain accepted only for single whole-object patches or unsupported-only objects.

One shared four-neighbor RGB>=24 patch boundary map and bincount surface/boundary aggregation per frame. One ROI keeps one patch ID across internal triangles. All ROI rows, including zero/negative rows, retain 16/4/24 rules.

Session rebind detects ordered geometry change and clears observed state immediately. Images synchronize the new mapping before next-view selection. CoverageState rejects missing/stale mapping before duplicate-view reuse. Expanded existing mocked test observes the first frame before reordering and checks fresh SCENE receipt.

Host checks disjoint exhaustive supported/rejected source triangles. Full carries source indices. Brief-v2 preserves total/supported/unsupported counts, unknown component reason/ranges, per-ROI triangle counts, mapping identity and all pixel rows. Multiple ROI rows may refer to one object.

Host uses one geometry parse, one partition/index preparation and one patch mapping setup. Existing construction callback is before the real raster call. This review does not certify the unfinished outer controller or delivery oracle.

resolved_product_findings.original_issue: Frame cache mapping changed while CoverageState retained old observed receipts and covered_mask. Duplicate-view reuse could retain the old receipt.
resolved_product_findings.resolution: Final source authority-binds coverage receipts to the mapping and invalidates observed state on ordered geometry change. Existing face-order mock regression was expanded before any test execution.

reviewer_corrections.initial_error: Reviewer misread rectangle_mesh corner numbering and claimed [0,3,4] did not create a third incident face.
reviewer_corrections.verified_correction: Generated faces are [0,1,3] and [0,3,2]. Edge 0-3 already has two incident faces. Appending [0,3,4] correctly creates the registered nonmanifold edge.
reviewer_corrections.disposition: Finding withdrawn before source changes. Original fixture retained. This is a review error, not a product failure.

fixture_registration_readback.scope: Static readback of pre-candidate constructor records. No independent geometry evaluation or visibility/pixel certification in this review.

limits: Static review only. Runtime geometry, image counts, lifecycle, installed entry and timing remain for the parent-owned frozen acceptance.
Outer controller and delivery oracle are still being authored and are outside this source audit.
No performance, model-quality or administrator-acceptance claim is made.
